content.comment_body: I'm attempting to use a Memory/Battery card for [version_no]. The card's article number is [article_no]. Previously, it was possible to insert the memory battery card into a [company_name] [product_name] module and transfer the program directly from the module to the card. I recently bought two new cards, but they do not function as expected. When I try to load the program from the [product_name] module to the memory card, I receive the message 'Card Unknown.' Testing with an older card (same article number: [article_no]), it still operates correctly. Both old and new cards share the same code. What could be the issue?
Hello, Try switching off the power before inserting the card, then power on and see if it works. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: A user describes an issue where new memory/battery cards with identical article numbers to older cards are not recognized by the [product_name] module, resulting in a 'Card Unknown' error. The older card works without problems, indicating a possible compatibility, hardware revision, or firmware difference that affects card recognition and prevents program transfer or backups.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that newly purchased memory/battery cards from [company_name], which have the same article number as their previously functional card, will work seamlessly with their [product_name] device, with no compatibility problems or unexpected errors.
